rawFindings.title: Removal of resolver.isNotCacheable check in fetch leads to unnecessary caching attempts for non-cacheable resolvers
rawFindings.explanation: The change removes the check 'if (resolver.isNotCacheable()) { return that._resolve(resolver, logger); }' from the fetch method, which previously bypassed the cache for non-cacheable resolvers (local dependencies or branches). Now all resolvers go through the cache retrieval. This may cause unnecessary cache retrieval attempts and cache storage even for non-cacheable resolvers.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the isNotCacheable check in the fetch method to bypass caching for certain resolvers.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Fetching a local file dependency still attempts to retrieve from and store to cache, potentially causing errors or performance overhead.

rawFindings.title: _resolve method no longer uses resolver.isNotCacheable, inconsistently with fetch behavior
rawFindings.explanation: The _resolve method replaces the check 'if (resolver.isNotCacheable())' with an internal check for moving targets 'if (resolver._resolution && resolver._resolution.type === 'branch')' to decide whether to store in cache. However, other types of non-cacheable resolvers, like local dependencies, will now be incorrectly cached if they do not have a '_resolution' property with 'branch' type, causing inconsistent caching behavior with fetch which calls this._resolve for all resolvers.
rawFindings.suggestion: Either restore the isNotCacheable method or update _resolve and fetch methods to use the same cacheability check consistently.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Local file dependencies get cached in _resolve despite being non-cacheable leading to unexpected cache writes or errors.
